questions.question:
Select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6189388f40268606adab7a3291f6000f585d7350e4fda0f6327ee96ceaf57465.png]
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

In triangle, addition of bottom digits = center digit + topmost digit.

Example: in triangle 1:

2 + 8 = 5 + 5

also,

in triangle 2:

10 + 9 = 16 + 3

Similarly,

7 + 8 = ? + 1;

? = 15 - 1

**? = 14**

Hence, 14 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number than can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8b1987cc352547013905d19f80b2de4f2683b8ec663eb380405874a37901139.png]
questions.solution:
In the given figure top right corner has a square term.

The left corner digit + bottom digit = square root of right corner digit.

Root of 169 = 13, and 7 + 6 = 13

Similarly,

Root of 121 = 11, and 9 + 2 = 11

Also,

9 + 7 = 16, and square of 16 = **256**

Hence, 256 will replace question mark

questions.question: In a certain code language, 458693 is coded as 367784. How will 742351 be coded as in that language?
questions.solution:
In the given coded form:

The numbers are first decreasing and then increasing by 1

4 - 1 = 3

5 + 1 = 6

8 - 1 = 7

6 + 1 = 7

9 - 1 = 8

3 + 1 = 4

Similarly,

742351 will be coded as **651442**

Hence, 651442 is the coded form.

questions.question:

1. Quintal

2. Kilo gram

3. Gram

4. Mili Gram

5. Ton
questions.solution:
The logical and meaningful order can be increasing or decreasing order.

From option it is clear that we have to do in increasing order because each option has 4 at first which is Mili Gram (smallest)

Mili Gram < Gram < Kilo Gram < Quintal < Ton

questions.question: In a family, Mr. and Mrs. Gajanan have five daughters and each daughter has one brother. How many persons are there in the family?
questions.solution:
Given:

 Mr. and Mrs. Gajanan (+ 2) has five daughters (+ 5) and each daughter has one brother.

Each daughter has one brother this means if there is a boy in the family he will be the brother of all sister. So there is one brother (+ 1)

Adding all of them;

2 + 5 + 1 = 8

There are **8** people in the family.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All squares are rectangles.

2. All rectangles are polygons.

**Conclusions:**

I. Square is not a polygon.

II. Square is both rectangle and polygon.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
Statements:

1. All squares are rectangles.

2. All rectangles are polygons.

According to the given statement, the Venn diagram is as follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39373941df0f10a729a40763a2dcf14ae52ba112ee431650fe402917d4e0ac05.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Square is not a polygon. (False, as all squares are rectangles and all rectangles are polygon. So all squares are polygon)

II. Square is both rectangle and polygon. (True, as all squares are rectangles and all rectangles are polygon. So all squares are polygon)

Hence, Only conclusion II follows.
